sections.title: Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports
sections.description: CEOs and CFOs must certify the accuracy of financial statements.

requirements.summary: Certify that financial statements are accurate and complete.
Establish internal controls and disclose any deficiencies.

sections.title: Management Assessment of Internal Controls
sections.description: Management must evaluate and report on internal control effectiveness.

requirements.summary: Management's responsibility to maintain effective internal controls.
Independent auditor must attest to the internal control assessment.
